mapper.insert: insert ignore into refund_flow( flow_no, order_id, user_id, refund_channel, channel_refund_no, refund_amount, refund_status, refund_reason, refund_time, raw_message, create_time, update_time ) values( #{flowNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{refundChannel}, #{channelRefundNo}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{refundReason}, #{refundTime}, #{rawMessage}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select count(1) from refund_flow rf left join third_party_bill tb on tb.order_id = rf.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' where rf.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' and tb.id is null

select rf.id, rf.flow_no, rf.order_id, rf.user_id, rf.refund_channel, rf.channel_refund_no, rf.refund_amount, rf.refund_status, rf.refund_reason, rf.refund_time, rf.raw_message, rf.create_time, rf.update_time from refund_flow rf left join third_party_bill tb on tb.order_id = rf.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' where rf.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' and tb.id is null order by rf.refund_time asc limit #{limit}
